name: High school Life: HSL
source:
Will you succeed in marrying the girl of your dream?
Or Will you remain alone till the end of your life?

You have to find someone to marry before your next birthday or your father will force you to marry his company president daughter.

Are you interesting in younger girl? 
Same age? 
Older type? 
Or in all of them?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=36258]Lemmasoft Forums[/url]]
translation:
你能成功和梦中情人结婚吗？

还是会孤独终老？

你必须在下一个生日之前找到结婚对象，否则父亲就会强迫你迎娶公司社长的女儿。

你喜欢年纪比自己小的女孩吗？
同龄女孩？
年长类型？
还是全都喜欢？
